description: A static utility class providing methods to load various image and PDF resources from the file system, including enums for different image types and helper methods for resource retrieval.

classes.name: ImageHelper
classes.description: A static class providing methods to load images and PDFs from the file system, with enums for different image types.

methods.name: GetBmpImage
methods.description: Returns a BMP image as an XImage object based on the specified BmpImages enum.

methods.name: GetGifImage
methods.description: Returns a GIF image as an XImage object based on the specified GifImages enum.

methods.name: GetJpegImage
methods.description: Returns a JPEG image as an XImage object based on the JpegImages enum.

methods.name: GetPngImage
methods.description: Returns a PNG image as an XImage object based on the PngImages enum.

methods.name: GetTiffImage
methods.description: Returns a TIFF image as an XImage object based on the TiffImages enum.

methods.name: GetPdfFile
methods.description: Returns a PDF document based on the specified PdfFiles enum.

methods.name: GetPdfForm
methods.description: Returns a PDF form object based on the specified PdfFiles enum.
